heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear. Areas of valley fog, and some frost possible in the cold spots. Lows in the 30s to low 40s, a few low 30s possible in the northeast. Wind becoming light and variable.

heading: Sunday
text: Sunshine, mixing with periods of clouds. Cool. Highs in the low to mid 60s. Light wind turning south at 5 to 10 mph, stronger speeds over Lake Champlain.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Becoming mostly cloudy. A chance of scattered showers late north of Route 2. Lows in the 40s to near 50. Light south wind, stronger over Lake Champlain.
